reference: T004 and T013 device record of the FE-001 candidate: the mini program runs on an actual iPhone through WeChat DevTools 真机调试 over LAN (no Simulator), the bootstrap reads SDK 3.18.1 in-app via wx.getAppBaseInfo(), and for T013 the exact candidate was rebuilt and re-run on the device with package size, request measurements and startup behavior recorded. T004 was evidenced at 16:17 local when the page set was the bootstrap plus runtime and lifecycle probes; the final candidate adds the backend identity and chunked stream probe pages, whose device runs are recorded below.

design.selector: Real-device Acceptance 记录设备/系统/微信/基础库/DevTools、构建、后端环境、操作、实际结果以及相关缺陷。

environment: Device: iPhone 16 (iPhone17,3), iOS 26.6.2, WeChat 8.0.80; runtime base library SDK 3.18.1 read in-app via wx.getAppBaseInfo().SDKVersion. Runtime path: WeChat DevTools cask 2.02.2609250 (app build 36.6.0) 真机调试 over LAN, not the Simulator. Probe server: Node 26.13.0 on macOS 26.6.2 arm64 listening on http://192.168.2.135:8791 (all interfaces), logging the peer address and User-Agent; phone peer 192.168.2.212, UA MicroMessenger/8.0.80 NetType/WIFI. AppID wx746a39363f67ae95. Isolated technical probe only: no backend, production service, real family data, or production credentials involved. T013 additions: the preview rebuild was executed at 20:19 local with cli preview (AppID wx746a39363f67ae95) against the committed candidate tree and reported preview package TOTAL 86.5 KB (88573 bytes). The final device re-run is the accepted 20:13:17Z-20:14:04Z chunk probe run whose implementation file hashes equal this record. The retained device-bootstrap-final.jpg was captured at 16:17 local for T004 when the bootstrap exposed the runtime and lifecycle probe buttons; the final four-page navigation is evidenced by the backend identity probe run (16:43 local) and the chunk probe run (20:13 local), both opened from the bootstrap.

operations.action: Compile and open the final candidate on the actual target iPhone through WeChat DevTools 真机调试 over LAN
operations.expected: The final candidate compiles for device use and opens in WeChat on the phone without white screen or error prompt, not in the IDE Simulator
operations.actual: The mini program opened on the iPhone with the DevTools 真机调试 "已连接" overlay visible; the page rendered normally with no white screen and no error prompt. The 真机调试 panel is only present on a physical device session, and the later lifecycle upload independently reported platform ios, model iPhone 16<iPhone17,3> from the same device

operations.action: Read the two bootstrap lines on the device screen
operations.expected: The "FE-001 bootstrap" marker and the actual runtime SDK version are both displayed
operations.actual: Owner observed "FE-001 bootstrap" and "SDK 3.18.1" displayed at 16:17 local; the SDK value is read at runtime in onLoad from wx.getAppBaseInfo().SDKVersion, not from DevTools simulator metadata

operations.action: Confirm the final candidate page set is present on the device
operations.expected: The bootstrap page exposes navigation to the runtime and lifecycle probe pages included in the final candidate
operations.actual: Both "runtime probe" and "lifecycle probe" buttons rendered on the phone, and the lifecycle probe page was subsequently opened and executed from the same session, confirming the final candidate page set (including apps/miniprogram/probes/lifecycle) was running on the device

operations.action: Capture a device screenshot of the running final candidate
operations.expected: A real screenshot of the current candidate showing the bootstrap lines is retained as acceptance media
operations.actual: Screenshot taken 2026-11-28 16:17 local (1080x2341) showing the 小树荫助手 title bar, "FE-001 bootstrap", "SDK 3.18.1" and the two probe buttons; only status-bar system indicators (time, signal, Wi-Fi, battery) are visible, no account or personal data

operations.action: T013: rebuild the committed candidate with the frozen DevTools CLI
operations.expected: The native TypeScript build succeeds and reports the package size of the final candidate
operations.actual: cli preview --project <repo> --qr-format terminal exit 0 at 20:19 local; AppID wx746a39363f67ae95 resolved; preview package TOTAL 86.5 KB (88573 bytes)

operations.action: T013: re-run the exact candidate on the actual iPhone
operations.expected: The final candidate (bootstrap plus runtime, lifecycle, backend identity and chunk probe pages) runs on the device and reaches the probe pages from the bootstrap
operations.actual: Fresh 真机调试 session established at 19:47 local after the DevTools restart; the bootstrap rendered without white screen, and the backend identity probe (16:43 local, identical page files) and the chunk probe (20:13 local) were opened and executed from it; the chunk run is the accepted T012 run

operations.action: T013: record request measurements from the device runs
operations.expected: Actual request timings are recorded rather than estimated
operations.actual: Backend request log responseTime: POST /api/v1/auth/wechat 94.87 ms, authenticated GET /api/v1/me 27.39 ms, unauthenticated GET /api/v1/me 1.97 ms. Chunk probe: 6 chunks / 137 bytes over span 2003 ms; the buffered control delivered one complete 137-byte body; the 40-chunk background stream completed with span 19545 ms; the 40-chunk network stream completed after a 6482 ms interference gap between chunk arrivals

operations.action: T013: observe startup behavior of the final candidate on the device
operations.expected: The candidate starts on the device and reaches an interactive page
operations.actual: The candidate opened in the 真机调试 session with the 已连接 overlay; the bootstrap rendered without white screen or error prompt and the first navigation to the chunk probe page completed and started the run. Cold-start duration in milliseconds is not separately instrumented in this probe-only slice (recorded as a non-blocking defect), so no numeric cold-start value is claimed

defects.description: Cold-start duration is not instrumented in milliseconds for this probe-only slice; startup was observed end-to-end on the device (bootstrap rendered without white screen, first navigation and probe run completed) but no numeric cold-start metric is claimed.
